items.source: As of 7.0, this interface also allows for exposing additional object types for dependency injection through implementing a pair of methods: getObject(Class) as well as supportsType(Class). The primary FactoryBean.getObjectType() will be exposed for regular access; only if a specific type is requested, additional types are considered. The container will not cache SmartFactoryBean-produced objects; make sure that the getObject implementation is thread-safe for repeated invocations.
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起，该接口还允许通过实现一对方法来暴露额外的对象类型以进行依赖注入：getObject(Class) 以及 supportsType(Class)。常规的 FactoryBean.getObjectType() 将用于常规访问；仅在请求特定类型时，才会考虑额外的类型。容器不会缓存由 SmartFactoryBean 生成的对象；请确保 getObject 的实现对于重复调用是线程安全的。

items.source: A standard FactoryBean is not expected to initialize eagerly: Its FactoryBean.getObject() will only be called for actual access, even in case of a singleton object. Returning true from this method suggests that FactoryBean.getObject() should be called eagerly, also applying post-processors eagerly. This may make sense in case of a singleton object, in particular if post-processors expect to be applied on startup.
items.translation: 标准 FactoryBean 不应被急切初始化：其FactoryBean.getObject()仅在真正访问时才会被调用，即使对于单例对象也是如此。从此方法返回true表明应急切调用FactoryBean.getObject()，同时也应急切应用后置处理器。在单例对象的情况下这可能是有意义的，特别是当后置处理器期望在启动时应用时。

items.source: By default, this supports the primary type exposed by the factory, as indicated by FactoryBean.getObjectType() and returned by FactoryBean.getObject(). Specific factories may support additional types for dependency injection.
items.translation: 默认情况下，它支持工厂公开的主要类型，如FactoryBean.getObjectType()所示，并由FactoryBean.getObject()返回。特定工厂可能支持用于依赖注入的额外类型。

items.source: NOTE: This interface is a special purpose interface, mainly for internal use within the framework and within collaborating frameworks. In general, application-provided FactoryBeans should simply implement the plain FactoryBean interface. New methods might be added to this extended interface even in point releases.
items.translation: 注意：此接口是一个专用接口，主要用于框架内部以及协作框架内部。通常情况下，应用程序提供的 FactoryBeans 只需实现普通的 FactoryBean 接口。即使是在点版本中，也可能向此扩展接口添加新方法。

items.source: This method is supposed to strictly check for independent instances; it should not return true for scoped objects or other kinds of non-singleton, non-independent objects. For this reason, this is not simply the inverted form of FactoryBean.isSingleton().
items.translation: 此方法应严格检查独立实例；对于作用域对象或其他非单例、非独立对象，不应返回 `true`。因此，这并非简单地作为 FactoryBean.isSingleton() 的反转形式。

items.source: By default, this supports the primary type exposed by the factory, as indicated by FactoryBean.getObjectType(). Specific factories may support additional types for dependency injection.
items.translation: 默认情况下，它支持工厂公开的主要类型，如FactoryBean.getObjectType()所示。特定工厂可能支持用于依赖注入的额外类型。

items.source: The prototype status of the FactoryBean itself will generally be provided by the owning BeanFactory; usually, it has to be defined as singleton there.
items.translation: FactoryBean 本身的原型状态通常由拥有它的BeanFactory提供；通常，它在那里必须被定义为单例。

items.source: The default implementation returns false.
items.translation: 默认实现返回false。

items.source: Is the object managed by this factory a prototype? That is, will FactoryBean.getObject() always return an independent instance?
items.translation: 该工厂管理的对象是否为原型？也就是说，FactoryBean.getObject() 是否总是返回一个独立的实例？

items.source: true if getObject(Class) is able to return a corresponding instance, false otherwise
items.translation: 如果 `getObject(Class)` 能够返回对应的实例，则为 `true`，否则为 `false`。

items.source: type - the requested type
items.translation: type - 请求的类型

items.source: a corresponding instance managed by this factory, or null if none available
items.translation: 由该工厂管理的对应实例，若无可用实例则为null

items.source: whether the exposed object is a prototype
items.translation: 已暴露的对象是否为原型

items.source: whether eager initialization applies
items.translation: 是否适用急切初始化

items.source: Return an instance of the given type, if supported by this factory.
items.translation: 如果该工厂支持，则返回给定类型的实例。

items.source:
Does this FactoryBean expect eager initialization, that is,
eagerly initialize itself as well as expect eager initialization
of its singleton object (if any)?
items.translation: 这个 FactoryBean 是否期望急切初始化，即，它自身是否也进行急切初始化，并且（如果有）其单例对象是否也期望急切初始化？

items.source: Determine whether this factory supports the requested type.
items.translation: 确定该工厂是否支持请求的类型。

items.source: T - the bean type
items.translation: T - 圈类型

items.source: Exception - in case of creation errors
items.translation: Exception - 在创建错误时
